sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents_fts" USING fts5(title, issuer, ocr_text, tags, content = 'documents', content_rowid = 'rowid', tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "relation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'self', "avatar" TEXT NULL, "dob" TEXT NULL, "blood_group" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '📁', "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id), "folder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES folders (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "issuer" TEXT NULL, "ref_number" TEXT NULL, "issue_date" TEXT NULL, "expiry_date" TEXT NULL, "expiry_alerts" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PKR', "due_date" TEXT NULL, "period_month" TEXT NULL, "ocr_text" TEXT NULL, "classification_confidence" REAL NULL, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scan', "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "renewed_by_id" TEXT NULL, "expiry_prompted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER documents_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON documents BEGIN INSERT INTO documents_fts ("rowid", title, issuer, ocr_text, tags) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.issuer, new.ocr_text, new.tags);END

CREATE TRIGGER documents_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON documents BEGIN INSERT INTO documents_fts (documents_fts, "rowid", title, issuer, ocr_text, tags) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.issuer, old.ocr_text, old.tags);END

CREATE TRIGGER documents_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON documents BEGIN INSERT INTO documents_fts (documents_fts, "rowid", title, issuer, ocr_text, tags) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.issuer, old.ocr_text, old.tags);INSERT INTO documents_fts ("rowid", title, issuer, ocr_text, tags) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.issuer, new.ocr_text, new.tags);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "theme_template" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flagship', "dark_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "text_scale" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "app_lock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("app_lock" IN (0, 1)), "vault_lock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vault_lock" IN (0, 1)), "auto_lock_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "quiet_start" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '22:00', "quiet_end" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '07:00', "digest_time" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '07:30', "notif_domains" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "backup_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wifi', "day_capacity_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 360, "salary_day" INTEGER NULL, "salary_minor" INTEGER NULL, "language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en', "screenshot_block" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("screenshot_block" IN (0, 1)), "greet_style" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "greet_custom" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "currency_symbol" TEXT NULL, "week_start" INTEGER NULL, "date_order" TEXT NULL, "widget_details" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("widget_details" IN (0, 1)), "calendar_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("calendar_on" IN (0, 1)), "calendars_off" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "premium_until" INTEGER NULL, "premium_checked_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents (id), "page_no" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "r2_key" TEXT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'application/pdf', "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "enc_iv" TEXT NULL, "enc_key_wrapped" TEXT NULL, "thumb_r2_key" TEXT NULL, "phash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extracted_fields" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents (id), "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "corrected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("corrected" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "system_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atc_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "issuer" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "amount_avg_minor" INTEGER NULL, "due_day" INTEGER NULL, "expected_window" TEXT NULL, "cycle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "skip_months" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "installment_total" INTEGER NULL, "installment_done" INTEGER NULL, "remind_days_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed', "confidence" REAL NULL, "last_generated_period" TEXT NULL, "stats" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "ref_number" TEXT NULL, "schedule_dates" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id), "domain" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mind', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("priority" BETWEEN 0 AND 2), "duration_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "repeat_rule" TEXT NULL, "atc_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES atc_rules (id), "source_document_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES documents (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subtasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "fire_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("fired" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "atc_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES atc_rules (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PKR', "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'upcoming', "paid_at" INTEGER NULL, "receipt_document_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES documents (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "payment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payments (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PKR', "spent_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "receipt_document_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES documents (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "score_snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "score" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100), "components" TEXT NOT NULL, "drags" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_ops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "queued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conflict_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "blob_cache" ("r2_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_used" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("r2_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
